about: The MCA: Kingdoms 0.3.0 companion tuple (F04/F16). 'accepted' is the optional range in gradle.properties (never a launch blocker); 'validated' lists the exact jars used for acceptance, by SHA-256; 'publicSource' is the newest public commit inspected and whether it carries the contract; 'pendingRelease' is local work that is not published. A version string alone does not identify a contract: the pack's mcaquests-1.7.1.jar was built from local work and carries the current contract, while the public 1.7.1 source does not.

contract.needed_for: paid institutional workshop jobs (ordinary guild deeds work with any receipt API)
contract.without_it: Kingdoms refuses paid workshop jobs before any offer and reports 'paid workshop jobs: legacy_consumer_contract' in Server health
